date_taken: 1945 (during Lt. Wayne Miller's combat-photographer service in Edward Steichen's Naval Aviation Photographic Unit)
subject: Lieutenant Wayne F. Miller (1918–2013) relaxing in his quarters aboard the U.S.S. Ticonderoga (CV-14). Miller served in Edward Steichen's U.S. Navy combat-photography unit (1944–1946), and in 1953 became Steichen's curatorial assistant for The Family of Man — the only project-internal collaborator named alongside Steichen on the 1955 catalog title page. Resolves part of issue #166 (the Wayne Miller portrait gap).
